Maximum Power. Premium Comfort.

Serious Power for Heavy-Duty Work.

The KIOTI HX1401ATC-NA is the largest and most powerful tractor in the KIOTI lineup—designed for commercial farming, land management, and large-scale operations. Featuring a 140 HP turbocharged diesel engine, advanced Power Shuttle transmission, and a deluxe climate-controlled cab, this tractor is engineered for serious productivity.

With robust hydraulics, high-capacity 3-point hitch, and unmatched operator comfort, the HX1401ATC delivers performance and dependability in every field, season after season.

Features may include:

High-Performance Doosan Diesel Engine
Turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine delivers 140 HP with excellent torque, efficiency, and Tier 4 Final compliance.

Power Shuttle Transmission
24×24 Power Shuttle with creeper gears offers easy directional changes without using the clutch—ideal for loader work and row crop operations.

Deluxe Climate-Controlled Cab
Fully enclosed cab with heat, A/C, air suspension seat, and panoramic visibility keeps you comfortable and in control.

Category III 3-Point Hitch
Lift capacity of 10,300+ lbs accommodates the heaviest implements with ease.

Advanced Hydraulics
Up to 29.5 GPM total flow with three standard rear remotes supports a wide variety of attachments and implements.

Independent PTO
Dual-speed PTO (540/1000) with auto/manual control for efficient implement operation.

Heavy-Duty Chassis and Frame
Built tough for demanding field work and high-load conditions with 4WD standard.
